title: How to find partners for EU research calls

slides.heading: Why you need partners
slides.body: Many Horizon Europe calls require a consortium: research and innovation actions ask for at least three independent organisations from three different countries, one in an EU Member State.

slides.heading: Use the official tool
slides.body: The EU Funding & Tenders Portal has a free Partner Search: filter by topic, keyword, country or type of organisation and see who is looking for partners.

slides.heading: Start from the topic ID
slides.body: Every EU call has a topic ID, such as HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01-DISEASE-10. Paste it in the Partner Search, or open the call page and check Partner search announcements.
slides.highlight: Paste it in the Partner Search

slides.heading: Get in touch, or be found
slides.body: Contact organisations with the Contact organisation button in the portal. With an EU Login account you can also publish your own announcement, up to 500 characters.

slides.heading: Ready on our page
slides.body: In our link-in-bio page every EU call has a Find partners button and its topic ID ready to copy, next to the link to the official call.

takeaway: Looking for a consortium? Start from the topic ID and the EU Partner Search.
closing_cta: Save it for your next EU proposal
Open calls and Find partners: link in bio
caption:
Building a consortium is often the hardest part of an EU proposal. The European Commission offers a free tool to find partners for each call.

How it works:
1. Copy the topic ID of the call (on our page it is next to every EU call).
2. Open the EU Partner Search and paste it in the filter.
3. Contact organisations through the portal, or publish your own announcement with an EU Login account.

EU Partner Search: https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/partner-search
Open calls with Find partners buttons: https://clinical-chaos-dsv.pages.dev

Consortium rules differ between calls: always check the eligibility conditions in the official call.
